item.title: The Backstage Incident That Made KERRY KING Call a Rock Icon a 'Complete Jerk'
item.description: Not everyone in the world of music gets along, and that includes some of its biggest stars. Even in heavy metal, a genre known for its intensity and larger-than-life personalities, there are musicians who just don’t click.

item.title: THE BAND That Toured With Guns N’ Roses and Wished They Hadn’t: 'I Don’t Want To Be Around Them'
item.description: In the early ’90s, opening for Guns N’ Roses was considered a golden ticket, massive crowds, media buzz, and a shot at mainstream fame. For Soundgarden, a loud and rising band from Seattle, the offer felt like a fast pass out of the grunge underground.

item.title: The Night SLASH Felt Deep Shame Over GUNS N’ ROSES’ Treatment of METALLICA: 'I Lost Their Respect'
item.description: Back in the early ’90s, Guns N’ Roses were living the full-throttle rockstar fantasy, loud, chaotic, and unapologetic. Their shows were wild, their image untamed, and their reputation built on pushing limits.
